stable.notes: A device with several connectors can be drawn as one end per connector: right-click the node and pick Split Connectors, and each connector gets its own symbol, table and segment, with every wire measured from its own end; Merge Connectors puts them back on the node. View Settings has one tab per item (Table, Nodes, Segments), each with a live example of the node it was opened for; the table's columns are arranged on that example. A connector photo, pinout, connector face or protection label is hidden instead of deleted and comes back where it was.
